route: DIRECT_ANTHROPIC: IMPLEMENTED_NOT_TESTED (no live call made). AWS_BEDROCK: NOT_IMPLEMENTED. GOOGLE_VERTEX: NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
observed_mode: No live results exist. Every TESTED row is an offline result with a mocked provider or synthetic data.

capabilities.claim: Rejects requests without a valid bearer token, and its 401 does not reveal whether a token is provisioned.
capabilities.limitation: Offline only. Production auth matrix not exercised (BLOCKERS: deployed code, production auth-matrix not executed).
capabilities.permitted_demo_wording: "Access is token-gated; the gate is covered by an offline test suite."

capabilities.claim: Returns exactly five condition statuses (pass, review or gap) and derives the route mechanically: any gap means gap_identified, else any review means review_required, else ready.
capabilities.evidence: Source api/review-engine.js deriveDetermination; test-run-smoke.mjs checks 1 and 9 (mocked provider)
capabilities.limitation: Tests the derivation logic on mocked model output, not the quality of the model's judgments.
capabilities.permitted_demo_wording: "The route follows a fixed rule from the five statuses."

capabilities.claim: Rejects model output with an invalid status rather than guessing.
capabilities.permitted_demo_wording: "Malformed model output is refused, not repaired."

capabilities.claim: Produces a versioned Manifest from an Engine response.
capabilities.limitation: Synthetic records; a Manifest hash checks bytes, not authorship or correctness.
capabilities.permitted_demo_wording: "A versioned evidence Manifest can be exported."

capabilities.claim: Identifies documentation gaps in a supplier-access exception record.
capabilities.evidence: Smoke corpus S1 to S3 frozen; live run BLOCKED (provider key absent)
capabilities.limitation: No live output exists. Even after the run, five AI-constructed fixtures show fixture behavior only.
capabilities.permitted_demo_wording: None until the smoke run executes.

capabilities.claim: Routes an ambiguous record to review rather than ready.
Resists embedded instructions and fake delimiters in record text (no unqualified ready, no disclosure).
capabilities.evidence: S4, S5 frozen; live run BLOCKED. Known surface: ENGINE-DEFECT-REGISTER ED-05 (no delimiters).
capabilities.limitation: Two attack records cannot establish general injection resistance even if both pass.

capabilities.claim: Gives the same route on repeated calls for the same record.
capabilities.evidence: Two calls per record planned in smoke; formal repeatability R3 not planned
capabilities.limitation: Smoke agreement on five records is not a repeatability study (v8.0 section 17).

capabilities.claim: Agrees with the creator's blind labels.
capabilities.evidence: No creator labels recorded (decision sheet H-01)
capabilities.limitation: Creator agreement would measure conformity to Phillip's interpretation, not independent correctness.

capabilities.claim: Returns quoted evidence spans or offsets.
capabilities.evidence: ENGINE-DEFECT-REGISTER ED-07: the Engine returns notes only, no quotations or offsets
capabilities.limitation: Quotation-grounding checks cannot be run on this Engine.
capabilities.permitted_demo_wording: "Notes are written by the model; the Engine does not return quotations."

capabilities.claim: Evaluates the whole of a long record.
capabilities.evidence: ENGINE-DEFECT-REGISTER ED-01: input above 8,000 characters is silently truncated by the handler
capabilities.limitation: The evaluation runner rejects such input instead (test-run-smoke.mjs check 8).
capabilities.permitted_demo_wording: "Records are limited to 8,000 characters; longer records are rejected by the evaluation package."

capabilities.claim: Keeps record text out of JRS storage in customer-run mode.
capabilities.evidence: test-run-smoke.mjs checks 1 and 7; source logReview stores no record text but does store notes when authenticated with the service key
capabilities.limitation: Tested for the runner configuration only. The provider still receives the record text.
capabilities.permitted_demo_wording: "In the evaluation package, nothing is written to JRS systems; record text is sent to the model provider."
